get.summary: The latency from instrument to speaker: the device's input and output latency, the buffer, and the graph's latency along its longest path, block by block.

patch.summary: Renames an asset or sets its colour tag or favourite flag.

get.summary: Which stored presets use each asset, so a library can say what deleting one would break.

put.summary: Turns the tuner on (bypassed = false) or off.
Starts or stops scope frames (the engine's output waveform) on the WebSocket.
Starts or stops RTA frames on the WebSocket (the output's spectrum, or the RTA block's while a preset has one) and sets the bands, decay and window.

get.summary: The rig parameters: controller settings, scene level, tempo and modifier sources.

put.summary: Replaces the working copy's content (undoable; the preset keeps its id). Used for A/B compare.

post.summary: Listens to the rig while you play, then sets a Tone Match block's correction towards a reference .wav.

get.summary: A Cab block's current mixed IR (every slot that plays, DynaCab and IR pack slots included, cuts and smoothing baked in) as a stereo .wav at the engine's rate.

post.summary: Saves a Cab block's current mixed IR as a new IR asset.

get.summary: The Cab block's slots for its Align page: each slot's IR head, onset and delays.

patch.summary: Renames the working copy and sets its author, tags and description (undoable).

post.summary: Copies scene From onto scene To: name, block states, level, controllers and MIDI.
Swaps two scenes; the active scene moves with its content.

put.summary: A block's bypass and channel in one scene (the Scene Manager).
Scene Ignore for one channel: while on it, scene changes leave the block's bypass and channel.
Mutes or unmutes every output, the metronome and looper included; not saved anywhere.

post.summary: Puts one channel back to the block type's defaults.
Puts every channel of the block back to its type's defaults.
Sets a channel of the block (default: the active scene's) to a block preset from the Block Library.

put.summary: thru, mute, muteIn, muteFxIn, muteOut or muteFxOut; the 'in' modes let delay and reverb tails spill over, the 'out' modes keep the block listening while bypassed.
Replaces every modifier of the working copy.

patch.summary: Controller settings by rig parameter id (lfo1Rate, adsr2Attack, envGain, seq3, ...).

post.summary: Moves the block's settings to a new global block and links the block to it.

delete.summary: Deletes a global block; the blocks linked to it keep its settings as their own.

put.summary: Manual A-D (index 0-3), 0..1.
External 1-8 (index 0-7), 0..1: what a pedal or CC would set.

post.summary: Discards the edits: the working copy goes back to the saved version (undoable).
Empties the grid and the name, keeping the preset's id (undoable).
Stores the working copy, unsaved edits included, as a timestamped snapshot.
Puts a snapshot into the working copy (undoable).
Saves the working copy as a template.
Starts a new preset (a fresh id) from a template.

put.summary: Replaces a block with a new block of another type in its cell, keeping its cables.

post.summary: Drops a block on another: swap exchanges their cells (the cables stay put), replace takes the target's cell and cables.
Moves a whole row or column, shifting the ones between.

delete.summary: Removes every cable into and out of a block.

put.summary: Replaces every channel (and the assets) of a block with another same-type block's.
Sets a block's bypass and/or channel in every scene.
Replaces the preset's performance page.
Replaces the preset's own footswitch actions.

post.summary: Saves every block of the working copy (all channels and modifiers) to the Block Library.

put.summary: Plays a sine in place of the block's output (the cab resonance helper), or stops it. Nothing is stored in the preset, and loading another graph stops it.

get.summary: A Circuit Amp's speaker load resonance: the frequency at Load resonance 100 % for its model and Speaker load (with Follow Cab, the followed Cab's speaker), the current setting and the frequency it gives.
The user's presets by name, then the read-only factory bank's (factory: true) in bank order.
The user's presets (not the factory bank) as plain text, alphabetical, with their scene names.
The factory and user block presets, of one block type when ?type= is given.

put.summary: Saves a user block preset (factory ones cannot be changed).

Replaces the global settings: tempo mode, metronome, outputs (mode, Boost/Pad, EQ), inputs (calibration, gain), oversampling, Manual A-D, MIDI, footswitches, global blocks, scene recall (Scene Revert, Default Scene), the startup preset, Ignore Redundant PC and spillover.

post.summary: record, play, stop, overdub, undo, reverse, halfSpeed or clear.

put.summary: The next CC, note or program change received is mapped to this action ('midiLearned' event).

get.summary: Snapshots, newest first; of one preset when ?preset= is given.

patch.summary: Renames a preset or sets its colour tag or favourite flag, stored and live.

post.summary: Sets every Circuit Amp parameter of the presets back to its default, except the model's front-panel controls.
Sets one parameter on the matching block (same id and type) of each preset.
Block Library entries as a .cthblock file.
Adds the entries of a .cthblock file as new user entries.
Uploads an asset. A .wav IR can be processed on import: processing (asIs, autoTrim, minimumPhase), polarity (make the main peak positive), channels (both, left, right, sum) and maxLengthMs.
Blends impulse responses (levels, delays, polarity, peak alignment) into a new IR asset.

get.summary: The asset's file, e.g. an impulse response for the editor's frequency-response plot.

AllScenesRequest.description: Sets a block's bypass and/or channel in every scene; null leaves that part alone.

ApplyBlockPresetRequest.description:
Sets a block's channel (default: the one the active scene uses) to a block preset, or with `AllChannels`
every channel (a whole-block entry's own channels, modifiers and assets).

AssetUsage.description: An asset's metadata; null leaves a field alone, an empty colour clears it.

factory.description: True for the factory bank, which lists the factory presets and cannot be changed; null otherwise.

slots.description: Preset id per slot; null or missing slots are empty.

Bank.description: Numbered preset slots, as a MIDI program change addresses them (0-127).

BatchResult.description: Presets changed by a batch operation, and those it left alone (no matching block, or not found).

BatchSetRequest.description:
Parameter Batch Set: `Param` = `Value` on the block with id `Block` and type `Type` in each
preset, on `Channel` (every channel when null).

schemaVersion.description: The schema it was stored with. The store sets it on save, so a client may leave it out.

type.description: The block type id it is for, e.g. `chorus`.

factory.description: A factory preset ships with Cathode and cannot be changed or deleted.

values.description: Parameter values by id. Sparse: anything not listed takes the block type's default.

folder.description: A folder (category) in the Library, or null for the top level.

channels.description:
A whole-block entry: every channel's values (Dictionary<string, float> BlockPreset.Values is then the channel it was saved from).
Null for a single-channel entry.

modifiers.description: A whole-block entry's modifiers, with `Block` left empty: recalled onto the target block.

assets.description: A whole-block entry's assets (IRs, captures) by slot.

BlockPreset.description:
A named setting of one block type, kept in the Block Library: the factory's (the guide's "types" that are
presets of the same algorithm, such as the many choruses, flangers and reverbs) and the user's own. Applying one
sets a channel of a block to it; it never adds a Type parameter that would fight the knobs.

BlockPresetFile.description: A file of Block Library entries, as exported and imported (`.cthblock`).

BlockSettingsRequest.description: A block's settings (every channel, and its assets) pasted onto a block of the same type.

BlockTypeInfo.description:
A block type the editor can place. `CpuCost` is its measured cost in percent of one core at 48 kHz
(64-frame blocks, its most expensive type), for the editor's CPU estimate; 0 for built-in cells. `Pages`
names the editor pages its parameters sit on (each string? ParameterInfo.Page), in order; empty for one.

sampleRate.description: The rate the heads are sampled at.

CabAlignment.description:
The Cab block's Align page (`GET /api/v1/live/blocks/{id}/cab/align`): each slot's IR head on the active
channel, so slots can be lined up by eye.

name.description: File name for the result (".wav" is added).

CabExportRequest.description: Saves a Cab block's current mixed IR as a new IR asset.

CabSlotAlignmentInfo.description:
One slot: whether it has something to play and is heard, its onset within its own IR (the first sample within
20 dB of the peak), the delay Auto Delay gives it and its own Delay, in ms, and the first 10 ms of its IR as mixed
(cut and normalised, before level, pan and delay). It is heard at `OnsetMs + AutoDelayMs + DelayMs`.

DropBlockRequest.description: Drops block `{id}` on `Target`: `swap` exchanges their cells, `replace` takes its place.

DuplicatePresetRequest.description: Copies a stored preset under `Id` (a new one when null) and `Name` (the original's plus "copy").

EngineStatus.description:
Engine health. CPU and native figures cover the last 5 s window (native timing is measured around the whole
driver callback); overloads and the host's GC counts are cumulative since the host started. `Inputs` names
the hardware input sources the device maps (Input 1–4, USB 5/6, USB 7/8); the others are silent.

Footswitch.description:
One switch: the message it sends (a CC or note; value 64 or more is "down"), what a tap does, what holding it for
half a second does instead, and whether its LED is driven (the same CC or note, 127 when its tap action is
active, 0 when not). It answers only while its `View` is the active one, and a `Link` (a layout id)
switches to that layout after its tap action.

FootswitchLayout.description:
A set of footswitches on a generic MIDI foot controller. `Views` names its pages of switches (each switch
says which int Footswitch.View it is on); none means one page.

FootswitchOverride.description:
A preset's own action for one switch of a footswitch layout: while the preset is loaded, the switch at
`Index` of layout `Layout` does this instead of what the layout says.

GlobalBlock.description: A block shared by presets: linking a preset block to it makes its settings global.

tempoMode.description: preset (each preset's tempo), global (one tempo for everything) or midiClock (follow MIDI clock).

effectsMix.description:
Effects Mix offset (−50..50 %), added to the Mix of every block whose Global Mix is on: one control for
making the whole rig wetter or drier for a room.

noiseGateOffset.description: Noise gate offset in dB (−20..20), added to every Input block's gate threshold.

cabModelingOff.description:
Cab modeling off: every Cab and IR Player block passes audio through, for playing into a real speaker cabinet
without changing the presets.

outputs.description:
Outputs 1-4 (docs/08-blocks-parity.md §2): each one's mode, Boost/Pad and global EQ. Always four, Output 1
first.

copyOutput1To2.description: Plays Output 1 on Output 2 as well, unless the preset has an Output 2 block of its own.

inputs.description: The interface inputs, Input 1 first: each one's calibration and gain trim.

oversampling.description:
The oversamplers' filters in the Amp, Drive and Dynamic Distortion blocks: `minimum` (IIR, no added
latency, the default) or `linear` (linear-phase FIR, a few milliseconds of latency).

manual.description: Manual A-D (0..1): modifier sources a person or pedal sets, shared by every preset.

midiChannel.description: MIDI channel the rig listens on (1-16), or 0 for all.

activeLayout.description: The layout in use, by id.

activeView.description: The view (page of switches) of the active layout that is in use, 0 for the first.

perform.description: The global performance page: controls shown in every preset that has their block.

sceneRevert.description:
Scene Revert: off, changes made while playing (a bypass, a channel) stay with their scene when you come back
to it; on, selecting a scene always recalls it as it was last saved.

defaultScene.description: The scene a preset starts on when it loads: −1 for As Saved (the scene it was saved on), or 0-7.

startupPreset.description: The preset loaded when the server starts, by id; null starts with an empty preset.

ignoreRedundantPc.description: Ignore Redundant PC: a program change that selects the preset already loaded does nothing.

presetSpillover.description:
Preset-change spillover: on, the outgoing preset's delay and reverb tails ring out under the new one; off, it
stops with the swap fade (a clean cut).

confirmPresetChange.description: Whether editors ask before changing presets while the working copy has unsaved edits.

GlobalSettings.description:
Settings that belong to the rig rather than to any preset: tempo source, metronome, the global output EQ,
Manual A-D, MIDI mappings, footswitch layouts and the global block library. Stored as one document.

fullScaleVolts.description:
The peak volts at the jack that reach 0 dBFS (default 1 V, how Cathode always read its input). The amp and
drive models scale their input by it, so changing the interface's gain and this together keeps their drive.

gain.description: A trim applied to every preset ahead of the grid, −20 to +20 dB (Input 1 Gain).

name.description: File name for the result (".wav" is added).

align.description: Shift each IR so its peak lands at the same sample before the delays apply.

normalize.description: Scale the result to unit energy, like the Cab block does.

IrMixRequest.description: Mixes impulse responses into a new one (a Cab-Lab-style blend of mics or cabs), stored as a new asset.

asset.description: An asset reference of a .wav IR.

IrMixSource.description: One impulse response in an IR mix.

LatencyInfo.description:
Where the time goes, instrument to speaker: the device's input and output latency as its driver reports them
(each includes one buffer), the buffer itself, the graph's latency along its longest path (with the blocks on
it), and the total of the device and graph latencies.

LatencyStepInfo.description: One block on the graph's longest path and the latency it adds, in frames.

LiveState.description:
The rig as it is running: the working copy, which scene is active, and whether it differs from the library.
`Held` lists the blocks whose bypass and channel differ from the active scene's because Scene Ignore kept
them as they were: what they are running now.

MidiLearnRequest.description: Arms MIDI learn: the next CC, note or program change received is bound to this action.

MidiMapping.description:
A MIDI message bound to an action. `Message` is cc, note or pc; `Channel` 0 means any. Actions:
scene (Value = scene, or the message value when absent), sceneNext, scenePrevious, presetSlot (Target = bank
id, the PC number picks the slot), presetNext, presetPrevious, bypass (Target = block), channel (Target = block,
Value = 0-3), external (Value = 1-8, the CC value drives External n), manual (Value = 0-3), tap, tuner,
metronome, looper (Target = record, play, stop, overdub, undo, reverse, halfSpeed or clear), sceneLevelUp and
sceneLevelDown (the active scene's level by ±1 dB, then save the preset), save (save the preset), layout
(Target = layout id), view (Value = view index), viewNext, viewPrevious. A CC mapped to scene without a Value
selects the scene its value names (0-7), and a value above 63 steps to the next scene.

MoveLineRequest.description: Moves a whole row or column (`Axis`) from one index to another, shifting the ones between.

mode.description: `stereo`, `sum` (L+R on both) or `copyLR` (left on the right too).

boostPad.description: Level trim after the EQ, −18 to +18 dB.

eq.description: The output's global EQ by parameter id (graphic EQ bands g31...g16k and level). Sparse.

ParameterInfo.description:
A block parameter. `TypeLabels`, where present, names the parameter per value of the block's `type`
parameter (an amp model's own name for a generic control), empty where that type lacks the control: hide it there.

PerformControl.description:
One control on a performance page: a parameter of a block, by the block's id (`amp1`) so a global page
works in every preset that has that block. `Label` overrides the parameter's name.

description.description: A sentence or two on what the preset is and how to play it, or null.

factory.description:
True for a preset of the factory bank, which ships with Cathode and cannot be overwritten, renamed or deleted
(saving one stores a copy); null for the user's own.

controllers.description:
Controller settings (LFO rates and shapes, ADSR times, envelope and sequencer settings) by rig parameter id,
e.g. `lfo1Rate`. Sparse: missing ones take their default.

color.description: A colour tag for pickers and Manage Presets (a CSS colour name or hex), or null.

perform.description: The preset's performance page: the controls it puts in front of a player.

footswitchOverrides.description: Switches of the global footswitch layouts that do something else while this preset is loaded.

savedScene.description:
The scene that was active when the preset was saved: where it starts when the global Default Scene is As
Saved.

Preset.description:
A complete rig: grid, blocks with up to four channels each, cables and eight scenes. Parameter values are stored
sparsely; anything not listed takes the block type's default, so new parameters need no migration.

id.description: Stable instance id such as `amp1`; never an index.

channels.description: Channel name (A-D) to parameter id to value. Only values that differ from the default need to be present.

assets.description: Asset slot to asset reference (`sha256:<hex>`), e.g. `"model"` or `"slot1"`.

bypassMode.description:
What bypassing does: thru, mute, muteIn, muteFxIn, muteOut or muteFxOut (the "in" modes let tails spill over,
the "out" modes keep the block listening while bypassed).

global.description:
The global block this block is linked to, if any: its channels and assets come from the global library and
editing them edits every linked preset.

sceneIgnore.description:
Scene Ignore: the channels (A-D) on which the block ignores scene changes. While its current channel is one
of them, selecting a scene leaves the block's bypass and channel as they are; the editor, footswitches and
MIDI still change them, and a channel not listed makes it follow the scenes again.

PresetInfoRequest.description: Changes to the working copy's name, author, tags and description; null leaves a field as it is.

PresetMetadataRequest.description: A preset's metadata, changed in place; null leaves a field alone, an empty colour clears it.

source.description: lfo1, lfo2, adsr1, adsr2, seq, env, pitch, manualA-D, scene1-4 or ext1-8.

channel.description:
The channel (A-D) the modifier applies on, or null for every channel of its block. On another channel the
parameter keeps that channel's own value.

PresetModifier.description: One modified parameter; see Cathode.Engine.Graph.ModifierDefinition for the semantics.

ReplaceBlockRequest.description: Replaces a block with a new one of `Type` in the same cell, keeping its cables.

RtaRequest.description:
Turns the RTA on or off and sets how it analyses: `BandsPerOctave` 3, 6 or 12 (about 30, 60 or 120 bands),
`DecayMs` how long a level takes to fall away (0 = each frame stands alone), and `Window` hann,
blackmanHarris, flatTop or rectangular.

SaveAllBlocksRequest.description: Saves every block of the working copy (all channels and modifiers) to the Block Library.

controllers.description: Scene controllers 1-4 (0..1), modifier sources that change with the scene.

midi.description:
Up to int SceneMidiMessage.MaxPerScene MIDI messages sent through the rig's MIDI output whenever this
scene is selected, or its preset loads on it: program changes and CCs for other gear.

Scene.description: Which channel each block uses and whether it is bypassed. Blocks not listed use channel A, engaged.

SceneMidiMessage.description:
One scene MIDI message: a program change (`pc`: int SceneMidiMessage.Number is the program) or a control change
(`cc`: controller int SceneMidiMessage.Number, value int SceneMidiMessage.Value), on MIDI channel 1-16.

ScenePairRequest.description: Two scenes (0-7): copy `From` onto `To`, or swap them.

SceneUpdateRequest.description: Changes to a scene; null leaves a field as it is. `Midi` replaces the scene's MIDI messages.

Setlist.description: Presets in performance order. Each entry is a song part: a preset and the scene to start on.

SpeakerResonanceInfo.description:
A Circuit Amp's speaker load resonance: the model's (or the chosen load's; with Follow Cab, the followed Cab's
speaker's) frequency at Load resonance 100 %, the Load resonance setting, and the frequency it gives.

SwitchAction.description: An action, with the same vocabulary as MidiMapping.

TestToneRequest.description: The cab resonance helper's sine, in place of a block's output: on or off, its pitch and level (dBFS).

reference.description: An asset reference (`sha256:…`) of a .wav file of the tone to match.

seconds.description: How long to listen to the rig, 3 to 60 seconds.

amount.description: How much of the correction to apply, 0 to 100 %.

ToneMatchRequest.description:
Learn a Tone Match: the Server listens to the rig's output for `Seconds` while you play, compares it with the
`Reference` recording (a .wav asset) and stores the correction as the block's `match` asset.
